description: Access the leading marketplace in Spain directly through ChatGPT. This app allows users to search for second-hand goods, vehicles, real estate, and professional services within the Milanuncios ecosystem. You can filter results by category, location, and price to find the best local deals in real-time. Whether you are looking for a used car, a rental apartment, or local job openings, this integration provides direct access to up-to-date listings and essential product details.
